text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $80k with minimal overnight movement, while Ethereum continues its modest upward drift, signaling cautious optimism among major holders. The Fear & Greed index climbing into greed territory and Bitcoin's dominance remaining above 59% suggest traders are confident enough to hold risk assets, though the $74B in daily volume and mixed performance across altcoins indicate this confidence isn't translating into aggressive buying across the board. The divergence between Bitcoin's flatness and Ethereum's slight gain hints at selective positioning rather than a broad rally.
